title: Pool Service Estimating Software (2026): 5 Tools Compared
description: Pool service estimating and quoting software compared: quote approval, deposits, repair bids, quote-to-job and what each of 5 tools costs to quote with.
h1: Pool service estimating software: quotes, repair bids and deposits compared
body:
Every new pool account and every repair starts with a number: the weekly service rate you quote a new customer, the price to replace a pump or filter, or what it costs to bring a green pool back. This page compares five tools on just that quoting side: how you build a quote or bid, how the customer approves it, whether you can take a deposit, what happens after the yes, and which plan you need for it. Every fact comes from the vendors' own pricing and feature pages, checked 2026-11-28. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. For billing after the work is done see pool service invoicing software; for overall picks see best pool service software; and for every pool tool we track, the pool service hub.

UpBuoy, which we also track, lists "cost estimates sent directly to customers" on its pool repairs page and "Quote Generation" in the title of its lead management page, but doesn't describe how customers approve a quote or whether it takes a deposit, so it isn't compared here. See UpBuoy.

Quoting a new weekly service customer

None of the five vendors publishes a built-in calculator for weekly pool service rates (by pool size, chemicals or visit length), so you set your own prices and save them as line items or services. What differs is how fast a saved price gets onto a quote:

  • Jobber saves common services, pricing and add-ons as reusable quote templates, and on Grow lets the customer pick optional line items (say, weekly service plus a filter clean) before approving.
  • Paythepoolman pulls bid lines from your saved income items and shows when you last used each item in a bid and for how much.
  • Pool Office Manager uses selectable line items, so a customer can choose between options on one quote.
  • Pool Brain and Skimmer build quotes from line items; neither page describes optional or customer-selectable lines (unknown).

To sanity-check a price before you send it, our free job quote estimator works out a price from your hours, materials and target margin.

Repair, equipment and green-to-clean quotes

These are the bigger one-off jobs where approvals and deposits matter most.

  • Bidding from photos: Paythepoolman lets a customer send a repair request with photos from its app and turns that request into a bid, so you can price it without a site visit. Pool Brain and Jobber let you add pictures to quotes (Jobber's quotes with images are on Grow).
  • Deposits before you order parts: Skimmer (Scaling Up), Paythepoolman and Jobber all publish deposit collection on approved quotes. Pool Brain and Pool Office Manager don't describe deposits on quotes, so ask during the trial.
  • Financing a big repair: Skimmer is the only one of the five that publishes consumer financing on quotes (Sunbit, Scaling Up). Its page lists 3-month 0% APR plans for approved customers and 6- to 18-month plans with interest, subject to credit approval.
  • Turning the yes into scheduled work: Pool Brain creates the job automatically on approval; Skimmer and Pool Office Manager convert in one click; Paythepoolman adds the repair to the route or a multi-day project from the bid; Jobber turns approved quotes into jobs.
  • Chasing unanswered quotes: Paythepoolman's Open Bids report shows each bid's age with a one-tap text reminder, and bids past their valid-until date show as Not Valid. Jobber automates quote follow-ups from Connect. The other three don't publish quote follow-up reminders (unknown).

See pool service software cost for full plan prices.

Which one fits

  • Cheapest with deposits and quote reminders: Paythepoolman ($65/mo solo) includes bidding with deposits, profit per line and an Open Bids reminder report in every plan.
  • Cheapest quoting, any trade mix: Jobber Core ($29/mo billed annually) includes quotes with online approval; follow-ups need Connect and optional line items need Grow.
  • Big repairs customers may want to finance: Skimmer Scaling Up is the only one here that publishes consumer financing on approved quotes.
  • Quote to job with no extra step: Pool Brain creates the job automatically when the customer taps approve.
  • E-signature on the quote: Pool Office Manager lists e-signature approval on every account; Jobber lists signature approvals under Quoting.
  • Test it on a real repair. During the trial, quote one pump or filter job end to end: send it, approve it from your own phone, take a deposit and schedule it. Our software buying checklist lists what else to test.

faq: What is the best pool service estimating software?

It depends on the job. From the vendors' pages checked 2026-11-28: Paythepoolman includes bids with deposits and an unanswered-bid reminder report on every plan; Skimmer adds consumer financing on approved quotes on Scaling Up; Pool Brain creates the job automatically when a customer approves; Pool Office Manager lists e-signature approval; Jobber has quotes on its cheapest plan.
Can customers approve pool service quotes online?

Yes, all five publish online approval: Skimmer through its Customer Portal, Pool Brain with a tap, Pool Office Manager by e-signature, Paythepoolman from a secure email or text link or the customer app, and Jobber in client hub.
Which pool software takes a deposit when a quote is approved?
Skimmer (Scaling Up plan), Paythepoolman and Jobber publish deposit collection on approved quotes. Pool Brain and Pool Office Manager don't describe deposits on quotes on the pages we checked.
Does Skimmer have quotes and estimates on every plan?

No. Skimmer's pricing page lists Quotes & Estimates and Job Management on Scaling Up ($2 per serviced location per month, from $98/mo) and Enterprise, not on the $1-per-location Getting Started plan. Checked 2026-11-28.
How much does pool estimating software cost for a solo tech?

For one tech with 40 pools, from each vendor's published formula: Jobber Core $29/mo billed annually ($49 monthly), Paythepoolman $65/mo, Skimmer Scaling Up $98/mo, Pool Brain $115/mo and Pool Office Manager $125/mo. Prices checked 2026-11-28, before text credits and payment fees.
